Hi Elliot / Maya,

Thanks again for getting the PO across — excited to get Elm Analytics onto Redwood. I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (Elm_MAP_v1.pdf) to frame timelines and owners, plus the evaluation data checklist I mentioned.

At a high level I propose we: 
- Confirm core stakeholders and their decision roles
- Lock the evaluation success criteria and sample prompts by the end of week 1
- Run a 2-week pilot/evaluation window (week 2–3)
- Target production readiness and integration handover by the end of week 4

Can you confirm the stakeholders who will own the evaluation sign‑off? Also share any hard constraints on the go‑live date so we can tighten the MAP.

Proposed kickoff call: Thu May 21, 10:00 AM PT. If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite and include Monica (CSM) to lead onboarding.

Attachments: Elm_MAP_v1.pdf (draft MAP)
